dedupe_keys.name: indian village satellite imagery and energy access dataset

description: Indian Village Satellite Imagery and Energy Access Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Energy demand", published or maintained by Kyle Bradbury  (Duke University Energy Initiative ). This dataset contains remote sensing data for every village in the state of Bihar, India. For most of these villages, the data contains the corresponding electrification rate as reported by the Garv data platform from the Indian government as of July 2017. Coverage: India. It has 2 files in CSV. The portal files it under Energy access, Energy demand. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
